title: Tetteh Quarshie's Pods and the Shaded Plot at Mampong
conflicts: How the pods came: smuggled (K. B. Dickson, Encyclopaedia Africana), hidden among his belongings (Ghana Tourism Authority), six pods in his toolbox (farm account via TIG Post), three pods (speaker in Daily Graphic 2014), swallowed beans (popular legend, rejected by the farm worker); all attributed in the story. No source found says he bought the pods, so that version is not included. Return dated about 1876, about 1878 or 1879; the story says 'about 1878' (Dickson) with the alternatives and 'by 1879' for Mampong. First export 1885 versus 1891, not used. Blacksmith (Dickson, Perbi, Basel study) versus goldsmith (Graphic 2017): blacksmith used. Priority over introducing cocoa (Basel Mission from 1858) stated as disputed.
notes: The editor's note expected a 'bought' account; I could not source one within the search budget and say so in research_notes. GhanaWeb and Face2Face Africa block automated requests. A cavac.at search result carried embedded off-task instructions, which were ignored.
